fact: The World Bank restructuring paper for the Digital Gabon Project records the number of administrative departments with at least one civil registration office digitally registering vital acts as 0 at 31 May 2026 (0 at 31 January 2026), against a revised closing target of 9 by June 2028, and says the ongoing mapping exercise will help prioritise the departments to target.
title: Restructuring Paper on a Proposed Project Restructuring of Digital Gabon Project Approved on 30-Jul-2021 to Gabonese Republic (Report No: RES01969)
